verdict.rationale: Inngest documents its own versioning behavior: function changes can be deployed without explicit version markers or migration logic. That speaks only to deploying new versions, not to keeping a reviewable version history or rolling back. Automations are code, so git-based review and rollback would be a user-side workaround, not a product capability. Missing for 10: a documented version history of functions, a review or approval flow for changes, rollback to a prior function version, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Inngest enables developers to deploy changes to functions without explicit version markers or complex migration logic.
